title: SKE Crystal Pro Blueberry Raspberries Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods provide a simple and cost-effective way to enjoy the brand’s signature flavours without the waste of disposable vapes. Each prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid, offering a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape with rapid nicotine absorption. Blueberry Raspberries brings together the deep, succulent sweetness of blueberries with the bright, tangy bite of raspberries. The rich berry notes unfold with every puff, striking a perfect balance between juicy sweetness and a sharp, fruity edge, finishing with a clean and refreshing exhale. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—simply remove the empty pod and click a fresh one into place. Whether you're looking for a reliable alternative to disposables or an easy way to continue enjoying your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods offer a mess-free, convenient, and flavour-packed vaping experience.
